actions.action: Inspect plant closely under leaves and in crevices for mealybugs (and ants)
Spot test 70% isopropyl alcohol on one leaf and check after a day
Paint 70% isopropyl alcohol onto mealybugs and affected stems/leaves with a small paintbrush or cotton swab
Mix 1:1 isopropyl alcohol and water in a spray bottle and spray whole plant including soil
Optionally rinse plant with water after bugs are killed
Keep plant out of direct sunlight after treatment
Use an air blower to move soil away and expose hidden mealybug nests
Follow up monthly to check for recurrence and retreat as needed

verdict.reason: The answer identifies mealybugs and centers on applying or spraying 70% isopropyl alcohol while avoiding direct sun afterwards, which matches the fix that worked; it includes no harmful advice.
